{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows', updating CMake configuration and CI workflows to switch native Windows builds from MSVC to clang-cl.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Migrating native Windows builds to clang-cl resolves ongoing MSVC internal compiler errors and significantly cuts Windows CI time from 20m 35s to 12m 43s. It also delivers substantial runtime performance improvements in block connection benchmarks (55–60%) and unblocks hardware-accelerated inline assembly on Windows."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates to build documentation and release notes are direct follow-ups to the build toolchain change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation changes purely document the switch from cl.exe to clang-cl and do not form the primary change."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/CMakeLists.txt only to remove MSVC-specific build flag adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Kernel build file modification is a mechanical consequence of the build toolchain transition and does not affect the kernel API or boundary."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "No P2P files or protocols are touched or affected.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR has no connection to P2P networking."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/test/util_not_null_tests.cpp only delete an MSVC workaround.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removing compiler workarounds in a unit test file does not alter test infrastructure or framework behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/compat/byteswap.h to remove an MSVC-specific workaround.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Cleanups in compat headers mechanically follow from dropping cl.exe support rather than reworking utility primitives."
    }
  ],
